name: textarea
summary: Several lines of text, a textarea inside its field: label, hint and error, Enter for a new line, with placeholder, read-only, disabled, required and invalid.

notCovered.name: the resize handle
notCovered.why: The browser draws a textarea's resize handle in its own colours, which no skin variable sets and no light reads, so the part turns it off and each box keeps the rows it is given.

notCovered.name: auto-resize
notCovered.why: UI SDK grows the box with its text by writing field-sizing or a height into the textarea's style attribute, which the check refuses on a stage, so no textarea here sets auto-resize.

notCovered.name: text taller than its box
notCovered.why: Past its rows the box scrolls and the browser draws a scrollbar the part does not style; every value on the stage, and the two lines the keyboard rows type, fit their box, so no reading meets one.

notCovered.name: the submit shortcut
notCovered.why: With submit-shortcut UI SDK sends the form on Enter or Mod+Enter; no textarea here sets one or sits in a form, so Enter always starts a new line, as the keyboard rows read.
